title: Tricky polar five-domain case
hints: Add the three remaining bond vectors.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\ce{ClF3}$ is AX₃E₂. Equatorial lone pairs leave two axial bonds and one equatorial bond. The two axial contributions cancel each other, while the remaining direction gives a net dipole.
statement:
Which pair gives the molecular shape and polarity of $\ce{ClF3}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: The unmatched equatorial bond prevents cancellation.
Only two of the bond directions oppose each other.
A seesaw structure has four bonded neighbors.
